products.label: Terraform Enterprise on IBM Cloud
products.name: deploy-arch-ibm-terraform-enterprise
products.short_description: Automate Terraform Enterprise deployment with supporting IBM Cloud services.
products.long_description:
Leverage [Terraform IBM Modules](https://github.com/terraform-ibm-modules) to shape and scale your solutions. You can integrate Terraform IBM Modules (TIM) to extend functionality and design a solution tailored to your environment and operations needs. These modules offer reusable, customizable elements that follow IBM Cloud's recommended practices. You can access the [source code and documentation](https://github.com/terraform-ibm-modules/terraform-ibm-terraform-enterprise) and use it to extend your current architecture or create new solutions.

This solution provides a fully automated, deployment of Terraform Enterprise (TFE) on IBM Cloud. Designed for scalability, security, and ease of use, it provisions all necessary cloud resources—including VPC, Cloud Object Storage, PostgreSQL, and Redis—within a managed and customizable infrastructure.

Ideal for: DevOps teams, cloud architects, and platform engineers looking to streamline Terraform Enterprise setup on IBM Cloud with infrastructure-as-code best practices.

features.title: End-to-End Automation
features.description: Deploys a complete TFE environment with minimal manual input.

features.title: Cloud Object Storage Integration
features.description: Automatically creates and configures a COS instance and bucket for TFE state storage.

features.title: Secure PostgreSQL Backend
features.description: Provisions a managed IBM Cloud Databases for PostgreSQL instance with service credentials for Terraform Enterprise.

features.title: Redis Caching Layer
features.description: Deploys IBM Cloud Databases for Redis for Terraform Enterprise session and queue management.

features.title: OpenShift and Kubernetes VPC Integration
features.description: Sets up a VPC tailored for OpenShift or Kubernetes clusters, supporting Terraform Enterprise deployment.

features.title: Customizable and Reusable
features.description: Supports existing resource reuse and environment-specific configurations (e.g., dev, stage, prod).

features.title: Security and Compliance Ready
features.description: Includes options for data retention and access tagging.

features.title: Composable and Extensible Architecture
features.description: This architecture illustrates how Terraform IBM Modules(TIM) can be integrated to deliver a complete solution on IBM Cloud. Each module is a reusable, and validated component for security, compliance, and operational IBM best practices. You can deploy this architecture as-is or configure it as code by leveraging the underlying modules to fit your specific requirements. Explore the [source code and documentation](https://github.com/terraform-ibm-modules/terraform-ibm-terraform-enterprise) to adapt, extend, or create entirely new solutions using these building blocks.

diagram.caption: Terraform Enterprise installation and its surrounding components.

diagrams.description:
This architecture automates the deployment of Terraform Enterprise on OpenShift or Kubernetes clusters with supporting IBM Cloud services:

**Core Components:**
- **Terraform Enterprise**: Deployed via official Helm chart with configurable version
- **PostgreSQL**: IBM Cloud Databases for PostgreSQL with encryption and automated backups
- **Redis**: IBM Cloud Databases for Redis for session and queue management
- **Object Storage**: IBM Cloud Object Storage (COS) for state files and artifacts
- **Key Management**: IBM Key Protect for encryption key management

**Cluster Support:**
- Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud (recommended for enterprise features)
- IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service (IKS) for cost-effective deployments

**Sizing Options:**
- Small: 2-node cluster, suitable for development and testing
- Medium: 3-node cluster, suitable for small production workloads
- Large: 5+ node cluster, suitable for enterprise production workloads
- Custom: Fully configurable cluster size and worker node specifications

**Security Features:**
- End-to-end encryption with IBM Key Protect
- Private network connectivity via VPE gateways
- Configurable network ACLs and security groups
- Secrets management via IBM Secrets Manager integration

**Automated Setup:**
- Admin account configuration
- Organization creation
- TLS certificate management
- Optional secondary hostname configuration
